---
title: MIR 1.2.0 F200 migration-origin source fixture
---

This source-only fixture prepares one disposable Factorio2.0.77 save from the exact published `more-infinite-research`1.2.0 archive. It is not a migration pass, current-package result, performance result, or release qualification.

The independent source facts are the selected objects from the existing native Defaults capture: data SHA-256 `7714C28BE891B81D3F8A598697F52DD0A678E3F3493600A96ECB7D7F1563745D`, settings SHA-256 `C512FBFDC2240D481B6A21E30764E1C82BAF2EC5238C01E6B2C4C80F0142C3C8`, and selected projection SHA-256 `A017240FA9AF6E438462F5417397DBC3768AE1CC0BDB0DF5EE9D5313E593F98F`. The fixture verifies all 34 MIR rows, their formula/time, ingredients, prerequisites and effect multisets, all 177 startup setting prototype type/default rows, and native `weapon-shooting-speed-1` through `-7` effect vectors before the only acceleration write.

It seeds 33 non-gear MIR levels plus player `weapon-shooting-speed-1` through `-6`; the foreign witness earns only `weapon-shooting-speed-1` and the detached witness earns none. It records those scripted seeds, completes one real gear laboratory, then retains source recipe, worker-battery, rocket/cannon/electric/flamethrower/bullet/shotgun gun-speed, foreign queued`.42`, detached`.27`, and all finite weapon state through the protected save and two read-only cold reloads. The earned source state is input for a separately reviewed successor; this fixture does not select or qualify a destination repair.

The raw-Git r01 preparation from commit `998f298056a43fd31cdeb49a4e061aa82e19b299` remains preserved: its five-member fixture archive is SHA-256 `303E8A24151513F425AC95706B81AE6DC1BE1A0019BB0E363B8EAAAE1779A519`, 10,077 bytes. It was never executed and does not contain the required finite-owner source state. The later packet retains it as distinct adverse/preparation custody rather than relabelling it.
